summary: The data flow matches, but required named members and exact read order are missing.
issues: Offsets 0x08, 0x10, 0x18, 0x1c, and the vtable slot at 0x24 are accessed as raw offsets rather than named members.
The P-code reads the value at 0x08 before dereferencing the object and loading the vtable slot; the reversed code does those reads in the opposite order.
fix_instructions: Define structures with named members at each listed offset and use those members in the function.
Load the 0x08 argument after the 0x10 object pointer and before dereferencing the object; then load the vtable slot and make the indirect call.
